My dear [Lady Sophia](/person/1133),
I am asked to send this card, in case [Lord Selborne](/person/1129) has a vote disengaged for this poor young man. I hope the Blind are not so plentiful as idiots and incurables from whom there is no peace![^1]
I suppose you have Dr Pusey’s life, it must be wonderfully interesting but it has not yet come in my way.[^2] It seems to fill up the complement of the other lives - I remember hearing about [Lucy Pusey](/person/1216)’s death.[^3] She must have been the flower of the flock.
Yours very sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: No doubt the Earl of Selborne was a subscriber to an institution for the blind, perhaps the [Hampshire Blind School](/organisation/25).
[^2]: Pusey’s eldest child Lucy Maria Bouverie Pusey (?1829-22 April 1844).
